name: sync-morphe-version

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch upstream versions
        id: upstream
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          TOML=$(curl -sH "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/MorpheApp/morphe-patches-template/contents/gradle/libs.versions.toml" \
            | jq -r '.content' | base64 -d)
          SETTINGS=$(curl -sH "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/MorpheApp/morphe-patches-template/contents/settings.gradle.kts" \
            | jq -r '.content' | base64 -d)

          PATCHER_VER=$(echo "$TOML" | grep -m1 '^morphe-patcher' | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)".*/\1/')
          PLUGIN_VER=$(echo "$SETTINGS" | grep -m1 'app\.morphe\.patches' | sed -E 's/.*version "([^"]+)".*/\1/')

          if [ -z "$PATCHER_VER" ] || [ -z "$PLUGIN_VER" ]; then
            echo "Failed to parse upstream versions" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "patcher_ver=$PATCHER_VER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "plugin_ver=$PLUGIN_VER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Update local files
        run: |
          sed -i -E 's/^(morphe-patcher = ")[^"]+(")/\1${{ steps.upstream.outputs.patcher_ver }}\2/' gradle/libs.versions.toml
          sed -i -E 's/(id\("app\.morphe\.patches"\) version ")[^"]+(")/\1${{ steps.upstream.outputs.plugin_ver }}\2/' settings.gradle.kts

      - name: Create PR
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          commit-message: "chore: sync morphe-patcher ${{ steps.upstream.outputs.patcher_ver }} / plugin ${{ steps.upstream.outputs.plugin_ver }}"
          title: "chore: sync Morphe patcher/plugin version"
          body: |
            Auto-synced from MorpheApp/morphe-patches-template.

            - morphe-patcher: `${{ steps.upstream.outputs.patcher_ver }}`
            - app.morphe.patches: `${{ steps.upstream.outputs.plugin_ver }}`
          branch: sync/morphe-version
          delete-branch: true
